basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square tutorial-card illustration for Matdo Check's website. Create ONE polished illustration, closely matching the provided Matdo Grade reference images in painterly style, palette, scale and composition. Soft hand-painted gouache texture, subtle dimensional shading, confident forest-green contours, rounded friendly objects, premium educational editorial still life. Cream #faf8ed background covering the entire square, a soft pale sage circular wash behind the central scene, a few dark green botanical leaves framing the subject and restrained warm ochre-gold highlights. Center composition occupying 75-85% of the square with all objects fully visible and generous cream margins. Forest green #1d3b34, teal #1f6f63, sage #7c9a6f, muted gold accents. No lettering, words, numbers, logos, watermark, borders or card frame. This is an illustration of a concept, not a literal app screenshot. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; create the following unique subject:
